# AI Moodboard Generator

Turn a creative brief into a moodboard of five distinct visual directions, rendered as square images in your ManyMotions account.

## What it does

Describe what the moodboard is for and the mood, colors, materials, era and style. Claude prepares the request and shows the credits required. When you confirm, ManyMotions writes five different visual directions (subject, setting, light, palette, style) and renders each with two image models.

**AI generation:** the media are generated by AI models run by ManyMotions and its model providers. Nothing is generated until you ask for it, and the credits required are shown first.

New images from a text brief only: no uploaded or reference images. Original directions only: no brand logos, artworks or artists named as the style, copyrighted characters or real people.

## Setup

The plugin connects Claude to the ManyMotions MCP server at `https://manymotions.com/api/claude/moodboard-generator/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).

- Preparing a request is free and works without an account.
- The first render asks you to sign in to ManyMotions (OAuth with PKCE; you can create an account on the same page). Rendering needs verified paid access and available credits on the account.
- A moodboard takes a few minutes: Claude reports the progress, then returns the image links. Claude Code works the same way, with text and links.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `prepare_moodboard` | Prepare the moodboard: the creative brief. Free, no sign-in. |
| `generate_result` | Start the moodboard. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_result` | Report progress, then return the image links. Read-only. |

## Example prompts

- "A moodboard for a Nordic cabin rental brand: linen, pale oak, fog, warm lamplight"
- "Moodboard for a summer streetwear drop, 90s film look, sun-faded colors"
- "Wedding moodboard: terracotta and sage, olive branches, candlelit long tables"

## Data and privacy

Your prompts and settings are sent to ManyMotions and stored in your ManyMotions account, and they are sent to the model providers that render the media. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.

- Privacy policy: https://manymotions.com/privacy
- Terms of service: https://manymotions.com/terms
- Documentation: https://manymotions.com/mcp#moodboard-generator
- Support: https://manymotions.com/support

ManyMotions is the platform formerly known as ClipWave.
